privacy.exportBody: We prepare a file with your account data and e-mail you a link. One export a day.
privacy.exportStarted: We are preparing your data. You will get an e-mail when it is ready.
privacy.exportFailed: Preparing your data failed. Try again.
privacy.exportGone: That export is no longer available: it expired or was removed. Prepare a new one.
privacy.deleteBody: Your account is deleted after a waiting period. You are signed out now, and you can sign in and cancel until then.
privacy.deleteScheduled: Your account will be deleted on {date}.
